import importlib, json
from pathlib import Path
from importlib.metadata import distribution
target = Path('/tmp/dialdet-wheel-we53axan/installed').resolve()
modules = ['dialdet', 'dialdet.artifacts', 'dialdet.audit_bound', 'dialdet.baselines', 'dialdet.certificate', 'dialdet.cli', 'dialdet.crossfit', 'dialdet.crowdhuman', 'dialdet.data', 'dialdet.demo', 'dialdet.detection_datasets', 'dialdet.development', 'dialdet.evidence', 'dialdet.exporter', 'dialdet.metrics', 'dialdet.objective', 'dialdet.provenance', 'dialdet.results', 'dialdet.risk', 'dialdet.risk_runtime', 'dialdet.solver', 'dialdet.statistical_workflow', 'dialdet.statistics', 'dialdet.study', 'dialdet.training']
locations = {}
for name in modules:
    module = importlib.import_module(name)
    location = Path(module.__file__).resolve()
    assert target in location.parents, (name, str(location))
    locations[name] = str(location.relative_to(target))
dist = distribution('dialdet')
assert any(e.group == 'console_scripts' and e.name == 'dialdet' and e.value == 'dialdet.cli:main' for e in dist.entry_points)
print(json.dumps({'version': dist.version, 'imported_modules': locations}, sort_keys=True))
